bugs.title: Non-English source audio must be automatically translated to English - faster-whisper's transcribe/translate task distinction is not wired at all
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. FasterWhisperTranscriber (pipeline/stage_a/transcribe.py) only passes `language` to model.transcribe(), never `task` - so it always runs task="transcribe" (stays in source language) and never translates. Required fix: (1) add a task mode ("transcribe" | "translate_to_english") wired to faster-whisper's own task="transcribe"/"translate" values; (2) when task=translate, language must be None (auto-detect) so Whisper identifies the real source language; (3) make translate+auto-detect the DEFAULT end-to-end (bot/src/github.js buildStageARequest options.language fallback, transcribe.py defaults, .github/workflows/stage-a.yml fallbacks, schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json default) unless an explicit preserve-original-language option exists (check first); (4) update transcribe.py CLI: --lang accepts "auto"-equivalent mapping to language=None, add --task defaulting to "translate", keep "transcribe" available; (5) persist into transcript.json both the task actually run AND the actually-detected source language + probability (info.language / info.language_probability, currently only logged ~line 156-160); (6) verify empirically with a non-English sample (English transcript out, detected source language recorded) AND an English sample (unchanged correct transcript under task=translate); (7) update existing pipeline tests touching language_hint / transcribe CLI / transcript.json shape, and add unit coverage for task-selection logic without requiring a real model download. | IN_PROGRESS: begun investigation of transcribe.py, bot layer, workflow, schema. | DONE (commit fd43d0d): (1) FasterWhisperTranscriber gained a task param ("transcribe"|"translate_to_english") mapped 1:1 to faster-whisper task="transcribe"/"translate" (no second internal vocabulary); when task=translate the language hint is forced to None (auto-detect) so Whisper identifies the real source language instead of trusting a possibly-wrong forced hint. (2) New default end-to-end is task=translate_to_english + lang=auto: transcribe.py CLI/defaults, bot/src/github.js buildStageARequest fallback (en->auto, added task passthrough), .github/workflows/stage-a.yml request-parser fallback (en->auto, added task output + --task flag), schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json (new task enum+default), and the two record-layer fallbacks pipeline/stage_a/ingest.py + pipeline/plan/series.py (en->auto) so no layer silently disagrees. bot/src/series.js now carries an explicit task choice across series parts. (3) Searched bot for any existing per-task/settings translation control before assuming - none exists (only github.js fallback + series passthrough), so translate+auto-detect became the default with --task transcribe kept as the explicit opt-out. (4) CLI: --lang default auto ("auto" maps to language=None), new --task defaulting to translate_to_english. (5) transcript.json now persists task, detected_language, detected_language_probability (from info.language/info.language_probability, previously only logged to stdout) so an English translation of originally-Japanese audio is distinguishable from already-English audio from the payload alone. (6) EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED in this sandbox with faster-whisper 1.0.3 (base model, CPU int8) on edge-tts-synthesized samples run through the exact workflow ffmpeg flags: Japanese sample -> English transcript ("Hello, everyone. Today, we are testing..."), detected_language=ja prob~1.00 persisted; English sample under task=translate produced the unchanged correct English transcript (detected en, prob 0.99) - no corruption/duplication; --task transcribe on the Japanese sample correctly kept Japanese source text. (7) Added pipeline/tests/test_transcribe_task.py - 7 unit tests covering task-selection/argument-forwarding with a stubbed faster_whisper module (no real model download in CI); no pre-existing tests asserted language_hint/transcribe CLI/payload shape (verified by grep). All 127 bot tests pass; pipeline tests pass except 8 pre-existing failures in test_cleanup.py/test_stage_b.py (YOLO)/test_status.py that fail identically on unmodified main (confirmed via stash).
